name: Browser hover
description: Hovers an element (by CSS selector) or a point (by x/y coordinates) in the visible in-app browser the user is watching.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器中，按 CSS 选择器悬停元素，或按 x/y 视口坐标悬停某点，用于触发 tooltip / 子菜单，操作对用户实时可见。
localizedDescription.en-US: Hovers an element (by CSS selector) or a point (by x/y coordinates) in the visible in-app browser the user is watching, typically to reveal tooltips or submenus.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to hover (first match). Supports optional frame:N prefix.

x.description: Viewport X coordinate to hover (used when selector is omitted).

y.description: Viewport Y coordinate to hover (used when selector is omitted).
